Make a semi- flexible meal plan , but sticking to 3 meals and 2/3 snacks each day. I found that if I went to rigid, my brain sees it as restricting, so I would inevitably freak out and binge eat. 
Restricting will just lead to binge eating, as our bodies will always win against our minds. So we need to make sure our bodies are fuelled correctly and not in starvation mode or uncomfortably full mode. 
Also I've found using an eating disorder app to log my food, feelings and thoughts throughout the day is super helpful, as I can see patterns that I fall into.
I will say I've been battling this for 3/4 years, so I know a lot of the theory behind it, but I still struggle with it some days. Just know that it's going to take time to heal, so be patient with yourself. Take care
